summary.name: Semantic Scholar
summary.one_liner: Semantic Scholar is an AI-powered academic search engine for scientific literature that offers paper search, recommendations, and an API for developers.
use_cases: building scholarly apps with an API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Semantic Scholar as an AI-driven tool that uses natural language understanding to help scholars find relevant scientific research. It offers paper search and recommendations. It also promotes a public API that now includes paper search, documentation and improved stability for developers building scholarly applications. A separate product, Semantic Reader, is described as an augmented reader that adds richer contextual information to scientific papers, currently available for select papers only. The page text is mostly promotional and gives few concrete technical details.
notable: Public API with paper search for developers
caveats: Semantic Reader is available only for select papers
Page text gives few details on limits or paid tiers
